description: Stepped-sine current excitation on stage S1 inside the parking loop (demo).
true_model: x/i = current loop wc/(s+wc) * two-mass belt drive (non-collocated encoder), see labs/06_drive/_model.py; plus 2 samples of delay and ZOH

test.note: each segment: amplitude faded in over 0.3 s, settling time 0.3 s (1.0 s within 5 Hz of the resonance), then the analysis window (measure = 1) of an integer number of periods (at least 3, at least 0.4 s) at full amplitude; amplitude grows with frequency and is reduced to 25 % within 5 Hz of the resonance
